source_clause: PRWEL2.2) Closing the popup will not have the prompts from the default Welcome popup for “Remind me Later” and “Don’t Show me Again”. Pressing X in the custom Welcome popup will be treated as “Remind me Later”.
leaf_desc_037: PRWEL2.2) Closing the popup will not have the prompts from the default Welcome popup for “Remind me Later” and “Don’t Show me Again”. Pressing X in the custom Welcome popup will be treated as “Remind me Later”.
reasoning: 驗證目標：7.2.2（PRWEL2.2）—— 自訂 welcome popup 之關閉不出現Remind me Later／Don’t Show me Again 之詢問，且按 X 視同前者。關鍵情境條件：popup 須為**自訂** profile 之 popup ——預設 profile 之 popup 行為在 6.3.1，兩者相反。為什麼這樣切：`design_method` 取狀態轉換 ——本條驗的是一個**壓抑狀態之建立與其於再啟用時之解除**。

tcs.tc_title: Closing a custom welcome popup acts as Remind me Later
tcs.test_item: Closing a custom welcome popup acts as Remind me Later
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Two Driver Profiles exist and Driver Profile A is customized
2. The custom welcome popup of Driver Profile A is displayed
3. The Welcome popup setting is on for both Profiles
4. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press X on the custom welcome popup
2. Read the screen and check which popups are displayed
3. Activate Driver Profile B, then activate Driver Profile A again
4. Read the screen and check whether the popup is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The custom welcome popup is closed
2. No popup offering Remind me Later or Don’t Show me Again is displayed
3. Driver Profile A is active again
4. The custom welcome popup of Driver Profile A is displayed again
tcs.priority_basis: 自訂 popup 關閉時不再詢問；罕見分支
tcs.remarks: **ER4 是「視同 Remind me Later」之唯一可觀察形式** —— 6.3.1 定 Remind me Later 為「關到該 profile 下次被啟用」；只驗 ER1／ER2（關了、沒問），一個**永久關閉**之實作會通過（§8.3）。故步驟 3 切走再切回。**與 `SWE1-HMI-PROF-051`（Don’t Show me Again）之結果相反** ——那一條之同位置斷言為「不再顯示」。**X-1**：步驟 3 之切換會觸發 5.3.1 之 PU0580，而該 popup **即 ER3／ER4 所涉者** —— 標的而非干擾。
